name: globex
description: GlobeX — full-stack travel booking (flights, trains, buses, car rental)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run photos
scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.render-build: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client --include=dev && (npm run photos || true) && npm run build
